review_notes: Reviewed the complete target file (lines 1–792), including its local lemmas, metric transport results, envelope constructions, and final robustness theorem. The one finding is a weakening of a structural assumption in a general-purpose helper; the remaining declarations are sufficiently tied to the three-dimensional model or their specific application.

findings.excerpt:
variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
lemma exists_smooth_local_log
findings.problem: This helper requires an inner product structure, but its proof only uses the normed vector-space operations, continuity and smoothness of `q`, and a compactly supported smooth bump. Finite-dimensional real normed spaces already have the required bump-function instance, so the inner-product assumption excludes useful cases without supporting the argument.
findings.proposed_change: Replace `[InnerProductSpace ℝ E]` with `[NormedSpace ℝ E]` in the variable assumptions, retaining `[FiniteDimensional ℝ E]`. The proof can use the finite-dimensional `HasContDiffBump` instance; the existing cutoff, logarithm, and compact-support arguments use only the normed-space structure.
findings.benefit: Makes the local logarithm extension reusable on finite-dimensional real normed spaces that are not equipped with an inner product, without changing its conclusion or proof strategy.
